# Introduction

The {{"template":"referral","description":"an energy-generating block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an energy-generating block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_stars:0.1.0"}}. It converts the kinetic energy of {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:rotor_blades"}} into {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}.

The blades cannot be powered with {{"of":"to_base:concept / minecraft:redstone"}}, only the steam generated from the {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_stars:heat"}} of an active {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler"}} can be converted into {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}.

# Stats

Information about a {{"of":"self"}} can be viewed by hovering over the item in an inventory.

The {{"of":"self"}} will convert 1°C of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_stars:heat"}} into 0.02 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}} every tick, meaning:

- For the minimum 100°C of an active {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler"}}, this {{"of":"self","text":"turbine"}} generates 2 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}} every tick.
- For the maximum 200°C of an active {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler"}}, 4 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}} is generated every tick.

{{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler","plural":true}} that are supplied more than 200°C are overboiling and are capped at 4 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}/t.

Using the turbine on a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler"}} that is only partially filled with {{"of":"minecraft:fluid / minecraft:water"}} will generate proportionally less {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}.

# Usage

{{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:rotor_blades"}} must be mounted to the front face of a {{"of":"self"}} to catch rising steam. The {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:rotor_blades"}} need an active {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler"}} directly beneath it within 3 blocks unobstructed.

Once the {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:rotor_blades"}} are powered by steam, the {{"of":"self"}} lights up and starts producing energy, which is output from the opposite face. {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:power_cable","plural":true}} can be attached to this output face, or a direct connection to an energy receiving {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine"}} can be made.

Since a single {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:boiler","plural":true}} can only supply between 100°C and 200°C of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_stars:heat"}} before the excess is lost, multiple {{"of":"self","plural":true}} are needed to extract the maximum {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_stars:heat"}} from a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/generator"}}.

# Upgrading

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can be directly upgraded into a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:steel_turbine"}}, a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier2","text":"tier 2 machine"}} with a higher conversion rate from {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_stars:heat"}} to {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}. The crafting recipe for this involves {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_stars:steel_ingot","plural":true}}, requiring other machines of at least {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier1","text":"tier 1"}}.

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can also be upgraded into a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_stars:gold_turbine"}}, a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier1.5","text":"tier 1.5 machine"}} with a higher conversion rate from {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_stars:heat"}} to {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}. This is not required to upgrade to {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_stars:machine/tier2","text":"tier 2"}}.
